description: This is a C# interface file defining the ICatalogItemService interface, which declares methods for managing catalog items such as create, edit, delete, retrieve, and list.

classes.name: ICatalogItemService
classes.description: An interface defining asynchronous methods for catalog item operations such as creation, editing, deletion, retrieval by ID, and listing.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item based on the provided request data.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item identified by its ID.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by its ID.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Lists catalog items with pagination support.
